Visible-only rule: hidden customer/schedule rows and hidden customer/schedule sheets are ignored. Schedule rule: a schedule must resolve to Previous / This / Next Week; unresolved schedules are not loaded.
BOM source priority: Standard ERP BOM when uploaded → existing BOM → learned ERP packaging patterns + Master Code fallback. The dashboard already carries learned 12xxx/14xxx/club-pack/combo behavior even when ERP BOM is not uploaded.

MCO / PA · Previous Week · This Week · Next Week

Mini Excel view of MCO / PA. Edit rows, add the remaining PA coverage gap when needed, select multiple numeric cells to total them, then refresh live balances and proposals.
PA —LIVE

Proposed Future Production

Customer/Coman = exact mapped command. Non-Coman Normal and LTO = schedule-aware PT recommendation using 35% / 55% / 75% / 100% period-completion checkpoints. LTO total target = Total FC − STD − OH. Horizon automatically runs through the end of P12 — and through next-FY P12 when the Next-FY forecast is loaded.
THROUGH P12

Material Check · Schedule vs Proposed Cases

Choose Actual Schedule or Schedule + Additional Proposed. Proposed is incremental after scheduled production is credited. OH + eligible PO is carried week-to-week; edit Physical OH or a weekly case count and every downstream balance/transition recalculates.

Lots · Remaining Shelf Life

Allergen = Milk only → Dairy (90-day minimum). Milk plus any other allergen, or anything else, → Non-Dairy (60-day minimum). Expiration is read from Lot Number.
